coaching.headline: Objective pressure won the game: allied objective damage nearly doubled the enemy's, outlasting Sparrow's eleven kills on TwinBlast and Argus.

flags.text: Every damn won fight got cashed: Orb Prime and the offlane inhibitor, a Primal Fangtooth, then two inhibitors.
Khaimera's 48195 objective damage led all ten players; Khaimera also landed the last kill before the Core fell.
Scarlett razed the enemy offlane inner and inhibitor and never died after the two early deaths to Terra.
TwinBlast's nine deaths were the shit part: six to Sparrow, three outside any detected fight.

focus.title: Cash fights, starve Sparrow
focus.action: Keep taking the nearest tower or objective after every won fight, and while Sparrow is off the map, TwinBlast and Argus walk the duo lane as a pair until Sparrow shows.

40.5.call: Lost 2-4 in the enemy half after Sparrow and Mourn killed Khaimera and Renna on mid first; the enemy duo inner still fell during the fight. Two allies down first means take the tower and reset.

43.3.call: Primal Fangtooth went allied, then Sparrow killed TwinBlast and Renna at the pit, and the enemy took Genesis Core and the allied mid inner. Leave the pit together after the take.

49.2.call: Won 2-0 across the allied jungle and the duo lane; the enemy took the allied duo inhibitor, then Primal Fangtooth went allied. Next time, leave one player on the exposed duo lane before the pit.

Zero kills and one assist for 5% kill participation, hero damage 32% under the norm. Once the enemy offlane inner falls, join the next mid fight with Swan Song ready.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Ran the vision: 21 wards, the game's most, against a norm of 6, with 60% kill participation. Keep that ward pace in every long game.

0c291b21-8a9f-4a24-8d43-e1ebe22a9306: Duo-lane rotation kills on Mourn and Sparrow each preceded a prize: Orb Prime and an enemy inner, then Primal Fangtooth. After the enemy mid outer falls, repeat the trip.
11.6 CS per minute against a 9.6 norm, and hero damage second only to Sparrow among all ten. Hold that farm rate whenever mid is quiet.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: A death to Sparrow at the Fangtooth pit, outside any detected fight, preceded enemy Fangtooth, then Sparrow took the allied duo inhibitor. Before any Fangtooth, group with the support first.
Kills on Countess and Mourn in two of three won fights; razed the enemy duo outer and mid inner. Siege only once Sparrow is dead or seen elsewhere.
969009b8-3895-4624-9261-e721482a0ff6: Back-to-back kills on Gadget and Countess in the enemy half preceded the first allied Fangtooth. With Countess dead, start the next objective before the respawn.
Hero damage 761 per minute on a 621 norm, and 10 wards against a 5.6 norm. Before invading the enemy jungle, ward the entrance first.
Two early deaths in the allied half, to Terra on the offlane outside any detected fight and to Countess on mid. Before an early offlane gank, check Countess's location first.

matchup: Duo was TwinBlast and Argus against Sparrow and Mourn; allied duo deaths before minute ten ran two to one.
Sparrow led the game with 13 kills and 62874 hero damage, out-earning TwinBlast 30243 gold to 29901.
Sparrow's Tainted Rounds cuts the target's healing on basic attacks, trimming Solaris heals and Manta Scythe lifesteal.
build: Solaris, Vanquisher and Tainted Rounds are the full winning core.
Vanquisher executes heroes taken below a small health threshold.
Demolisher, finished last, ignores a share of physical armor, useful against Terra, the top mitigator; earlier fights lacked Demolisher.
eternal: Xyris adds bonus damage that grows with units killed; Iron Will heals from basic attack damage.
Lotus leans first in the TwinBlast carry field and Xyris ranks well behind; Iron Will with Cull the Weak tops Xyris pairs.
augment: Spray 'N Pray makes Ventilate hit harder but less accurately at longer ranges.
Grenadier clearly leads the TwinBlast carry augment field; Spray 'N Pray ranks third, behind Amplified Burst.
crest: Pacifier's active dashes and empowers the next physical hit, much stronger on low-health targets, with a recast on hero kills.
Eviscerator and Exodus lead a toss-up in the TwinBlast carry field; Pacifier, the most played, ranks behind both.
improvement: Grenadier over Spray 'N Pray is the field-backed swap: an extra Vortex Grenade charge, a charge per Rocket Dash, less Ventilate damage.
Lotus for Xyris is the field lean: random stat gains over time and on takedowns, giving up the farm-scaling damage.

matchup: The duo threat was Sparrow, who took five of seven Argus deaths.
Argus killed Mourn twice and Sparrow twice across the duo war.
Mourn's Abduct pulls and Beguile mesmerizes; Countess's Feast suppresses, the main dive threat on the backline.
build: Timewarp, Tainted Scepter and Dynamo are the full winning core.
Dynamo makes an immobilized enemy take more damage briefly, so a Dread Nova stun sets up the follow-up.
Entropy, finished last, adds damage to ability hits; earlier fights ran without Entropy.
eternal: Vesh turns a share of ability damage on heroes into damage over time; Mind Rot adds current-health damage to the major.
Vesh and Lotus are a toss-up in the Argus support field; Lich with Mind Rot is the best Vesh pair.
Tithe of Death with Mind Rot is the most played Vesh pair but trails Lich with Mind Rot.
augment: Infinite Obliteration gives Synaptic Obliterator's beams infinite range, faster travel and a longer slow.
Arcane Engine and Infinite Obliteration are a toss-up in the Argus support field. Sound keep.
crest: Silentium's active silences a hero briefly and deals damage; the Visionary passive raises the ward cap.
Leafsong and Tranquility lead a toss-up in the Argus support field; Silentium sits at the bottom of the ranked crests.
improvement: Tranquility for Silentium stays on the Keeper Crest path: a team heal and brief damage mitigation instead of the silence.
Lich for Tithe of Death matches the best Vesh pair: magical lifesteal by level over mana and haste on takedowns.

matchup: Terra was the lane opponent: 4/0/3, scoring both Scarlett deaths and never dying.
Terra's Unstoppable Force cleanses debuffs and adds armor and tenacity; Wild Rush is unstoppable while channeling.
Terra's Tainted Blade cuts the target's healing on physical damage, trimming Solstice, Solaris and Terminus healing.
build: Alternator, Earthshaker and The Perforator, the full winning core, are all missing.
Rebirth resurrects after a death, but both deaths came early, so the passive had no death to answer.
Solstice, finished last, heals from basic attacks on heroes; earlier fights ran without Solstice.
eternal: Marrow heals from hero damage, more at low health; Roses adds takedown gold and a stronger Marrow after hero kills.
Knell is clearly the field's best Scarlett offlane Eternal; Marrow ranks second, and Leech with Jealousy is the best Marrow pair.
augment: Volcaic Slam makes empowered Cindara leave a rupture that erupts for damage and a slow.
Volcaic Slam leans ahead of Coup De Grâce in the Scarlett offlane field. Sound keep.
crest: Liberator's active cleanses debuffs and grants a short shield.
Gravitum and Iceskorn Talons lead a toss-up in the Scarlett offlane field; Liberator ranks well behind both.
improvement: Knell for Marrow is the field-backed swap: armor shred and stolen armor on hits, giving up Marrow's healing.
Gravitum for Liberator moves to the Champion Crest path: a long-range grounding shot instead of the cleanse and shield.

matchup: Gadget was the lane opponent: Renna killed Gadget twice and died to Gadget once, the last allied death of the game.
Gadget's Security Gate roots, and Tesla Dome slows and shreds magical armor inside the dome.
Countess killed Renna on mid in the enemy half outside any detected fight; Feast suppresses, Shadow Slip slows.
build: Entropy, Wraith Leggings and Overseer are the full winning core.
Overseer makes Abyssal Rift hit harder and heals Renna from ultimate damage on heroes.
Oblivion Crown, finished last, raises magical power; earlier fights ran without Oblivion Crown.
eternal: Vesh adds damage over time from ability damage on heroes; Millennia slowly raises ultimate damage across the game.
Lotus and Demiurge lead a toss-up in the Renna mid field; Vesh, the most played, trails both.
Lich with Mind Rot is the best Vesh pair; Lich with Millennia is the most played.
augment: Netherward grants a short shield on every Soulfire cast.
Netherward clearly leads the Renna mid augment field. Sound keep.
crest: Soulbearer's active gives a shield, magical lifesteal and movement speed for a short window.
Soulbearer clearly leads the Renna mid crest field. Sound keep.
improvement: Lotus for Vesh is the toss-up lead: random stat gains over time and on takedowns, giving up the damage over time.
Mind Rot for Millennia matches the best Vesh pair: current-health bonus damage now over slow ultimate growth.

matchup: Countess was the jungle opponent: 6/2/4, with Khaimera ahead on gold, 30133 to 23421.
Countess killed Khaimera twice on the mid lane in the allied half; Khaimera and TwinBlast scored both Countess deaths.
Every enemy built a Tainted item, trimming Draconum's takedown restore and Void Helm's boosted healing.
build: Overlord and Draconum are two of three winning-core items; Rapture is missing.
Void Helm adds magical armor and boosts healing received from all sources, useful against magical damage from Countess, Gadget and Mourn.
Imperator, finished last, boosts critical strike damage; earlier fights ran without Imperator.
eternal: Satariel stacks Fearless on takedowns for more power and attack speed at the cost of max health; death clears the stacks.
Lotus leans ahead of Satariel in the Khaimera jungle field; Demonic Bargain with Psychosis is the best Satariel pair.
augment: Jungle Invasion adds physical power in the jungle, doubled in the enemy jungle.
Jungle Invasion leans ahead of Lane Lurker and Feral Ambush in the Khaimera jungle field. Sound keep.
crest: Ortus's active adds movement speed and physical power, with permanent power from takedowns inside the window.
Eviscerator is clearly the field's best Khaimera jungle crest; Ortus ranks well behind.
improvement: Eviscerator for Ortus is the field-backed crest swap: attack speed, omnivamp and on-hit damage over takedown power stacks.
Eviscerator starts from Sharpshooter Crest, Ortus from Assassin Crest, so the swap begins at the first crest buy.
Lotus for Satariel is the field lean: random stat gains without the health cut or stacks lost on death.

threats: Chain-CC risk (3 hard-CC abilities, ~2.3s of lockdown): Gadget Security Gate (root 1s), Mourn Abduct (pull), Countess Feast (suppress 0.75s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Mourn. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 3 items of it.
Dive threat on our backline: Countess. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Dread Nova stun → Ether Crystal push/lift → Particle Shredder channel → Synaptic Obliterator beams
ourKits.winCondition: poke from max range and zone with the crystal
ourKits.playWith: a frontline to protect his stationary channel
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova; dive him during the immobile ult channel

ourKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
ourKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
ourKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
ourKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
ourKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs

ourKits.combo: Vortex Grenade → Vaporize pierce → Rocket Dash reposition → Ventilate ult
ourKits.winCondition: reposition with Rocket Dash and unload Ventilate from safety
ourKits.passive: abilities grant AS + a triple-shot next basic
ourKits.playWith: a frontline to create his free-fire window
ourKits.playAgainst: he's mobile but squishy — CC through the dash, then burst

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Wild Rush charge → Ruthless Assault → Highland Hurl slow → Unstoppable Force cleanse ult
enemyKits.winCondition: engage Unstoppable and grind with Hersir-empowered swings
enemyKits.passive: Hersir stacks empower the next basic
enemyKits.playAgainst: save CC for after Unstoppable Force; kite her charge

enemyKits.combo: Security Gate root → Sticky Mine → Tesla Dome zone ult
enemyKits.winCondition: root with the gate and trap a fight inside the Tesla Dome
enemyKits.passive: FDA stacks grant scaling magical power
enemyKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies in her Dome
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge the gate; spread vs the Dome — she's immobile, dive her

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
enemyKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
enemyKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
enemyKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

enemyKits.combo: Abduct pull → Contagion ally-heal bugs → Beguile damage-reduction → Eclipse vision-denial ult
enemyKits.winCondition: pull a target in and sustain the team through the brawl
enemyKits.playWith: burst that punishes his pulled target
enemyKits.playAgainst: respect the long Abduct channel/range; anti-heal blunts Contagion

enemyKits.combo: Shadow Slip in → Eventide → Blade Siphon → Feast suppress ult, Haemorrhage true-damage
enemyKits.winCondition: Feast-suppress a squishy and delete them with true-damage burst
enemyKits.passive: two-ability hits apply a %max-HP true-damage bleed
enemyKits.playWith: a team to clean up after her pick
enemyKits.playAgainst: Feast is her whole engage — bait it / peel; she's fragile, punish the recast window
